title: Oxbit Settings
description: User, private workspace and repository settings. Literal dotted IDs; objects merge recursively, arrays and scalar values replace. Unrecognized extension settings are preserved. Null is a value, not a reset, and must be valid for its setting.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI. Ignored when merging effective preferences.

agentACP.provider.title: Default agent
agentACP.provider.description: A built-in agent ID, an ACP Registry agent ID, or custom.

agentACP.useModifierToSend.title: Send with Ctrl/Cmd+Enter only
agentACP.useModifierToSend.description: Enter inserts a new line and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends the message.

agentACP.notifications.title: Agent desktop notifications
agentACP.notifications.description: Show a system notification when the agent needs input or finishes while Oxbit is in the background.

agentACP.autoApplyEdits.title: Auto-apply agent edits
agentACP.autoApplyEdits.description: New conversations save agent file changes without review. Undo stays available, and permission prompts still ask.

agentACP.generateTitles.title: Generate conversation titles
agentACP.generateTitles.description: When an agent does not name a conversation, ask the Oxbit Agent model for a short title after the first reply.

agentACP.oxbit.api.title: Oxbit Agent API
agentACP.oxbit.api.description: openai uses the Responses API, anthropic the Messages API, openai-compatible Chat Completions at the base URL, and chatgpt the ChatGPT plan's Codex models after a ChatGPT sign-in.

agentACP.oxbit.baseUrl.title: Oxbit Agent base URL
agentACP.oxbit.baseUrl.description: Origin and path prefix for openai-compatible, for example https://openrouter.ai/api.

agentACP.oxbit.instructions.title: Oxbit Agent instructions
agentACP.oxbit.instructions.description: Instructions the in-app Oxbit Agent follows in every workspace, after the workspace's AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files.

agentACP.oxbit.autoCompact.title: Oxbit Agent auto-compact
agentACP.oxbit.autoCompact.description: In-app Oxbit Agent conversations summarize older turns when the context window fills. Needs a model whose context window the catalog reports. /compact works either way.

agentACP.oxbit.compactAt.title: Oxbit Agent compact at
agentACP.oxbit.compactAt.description: Percent of the context window at which in-app auto-compaction starts. default compacts when less than min(20000 tokens, the model's max output, a quarter of the window) remains.

ai.inlineCompletions.enabled.title: AI inline completions
ai.inlineCompletions.enabled.description: Suggest code as ghost text while typing. Tab accepts, Escape dismisses, and Ctrl/Cmd+Right accepts one word. Each request sends the code around the cursor to the model provider.

ai.inlineCompletions.delay.title: Inline completion delay
ai.inlineCompletions.delay.description: Milliseconds after the last keystroke before a suggestion is requested.

ai.inlineCompletions.maxTokens.title: Inline completion max tokens
ai.inlineCompletions.maxTokens.description: Most tokens the model may generate for one suggestion.

ai.inlineCompletions.maxLines.title: Inline completion max lines
ai.inlineCompletions.maxLines.description: Most lines in one suggestion. The model is asked for at most this many, and longer replies are cut. 1 asks for the rest of the current line only.

ai.inlineCompletions.linesBefore.title: Inline completion lines before the cursor
ai.inlineCompletions.linesBefore.description: Lines of the file before the cursor sent as context. 0 sends only the start of the cursor's line.

ai.inlineCompletions.linesAfter.title: Inline completion lines after the cursor
ai.inlineCompletions.linesAfter.description: Lines of the file after the cursor sent as context. 0 sends only the rest of the cursor's line.

ai.inlineCompletions.contextTokens.title: Inline completion context tokens
ai.inlineCompletions.contextTokens.description: Most tokens of context sent with one request, estimated at 4 characters per token. Lines farthest from the cursor are dropped first; open files get a quarter of the budget when included.

ai.inlineCompletions.includePath.title: Inline completion: send file path and language
ai.inlineCompletions.includePath.description: Send the file's path and language with the code.

ai.inlineCompletions.includeDiagnostics.title: Inline completion: send nearby problems
ai.inlineCompletions.includeDiagnostics.description: Send the errors and warnings reported for the lines in the context.

ai.inlineCompletions.includeOpenFiles.title: Inline completion: send other open files
ai.inlineCompletions.includeOpenFiles.description: Send the start of up to 3 other open files, within the context token budget.

ai.inlineCompletions.disabledGlobs.title: Inline completion excluded files
ai.inlineCompletions.disabledGlobs.description: Glob patterns for files that never request suggestions or appear as open-file context, for example **/.env* or **/secrets/**.

ai.inlineCompletions.instructions.title: Inline completion instructions
ai.inlineCompletions.instructions.description: Extra instructions added to the completion system prompt, for example a code style to follow.

ai.provider.title: AI provider
ai.provider.description: Where inline completions and inline edits are sent. Oxbit Agent uses the Oxbit agent's provider and key. OpenRouter sends to OpenRouter. OpenAI-compatible sends to the Chat Completions API at AI base URL. Local sends to Ollama or a llama.cpp server at AI base URL without a key. Use Set API Key… to save a key for OpenRouter or OpenAI-compatible.

ai.baseUrl.title: AI base URL
ai.baseUrl.description: Origin and path prefix for the OpenAI-compatible and Local providers, for example https://api.example.com, http://127.0.0.1:11434 for Ollama, or http://127.0.0.1:8080 for llama.cpp. Empty uses Ollama on this device for Local. On iPhone, use the computer's LAN address, such as http://192.168.1.20:11434.

ai.model.title: AI model
ai.model.description: Model ID for inline completions and inline edits. With the Oxbit Agent provider, empty uses the Oxbit agent's model. Other providers need a model. A small, fast chat model keeps suggestions quick.

ai.effort.title: AI reasoning effort
ai.effort.description: Reasoning level sent with AI editor requests, for example minimal or low. Empty sends no level.

workbench.keymap.title: Keymap
workbench.keymap.description: Keyboard layout applied on top of the Oxbit defaults. User keybindings always win.

runtime.keepAlive.title: Keep Runtime Alive
runtime.keepAlive.description: How long a runtime Oxbit started keeps running after the last client disconnects or its connection heartbeats stop. Terminals and tasks continue while it runs.

runtime.autoReconnect.title: Reconnect Automatically
runtime.autoReconnect.description: Reconnect to the runtime after the connection drops, including when the iOS app returns to the foreground.

workbench.tooltipDelay.title: Tooltip Delay
workbench.tooltipDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before showing a tooltip on hover. Keyboard focus shows tooltips immediately.

workbench.colorTheme.title: Color Theme
workbench.colorTheme.description: Specifies the color theme used in the workbench.

workbench.density.title: Layout Density
workbench.density.description: Controls row heights, padding and label sizes across the workbench.

workbench.sidebarLocation.title: Sidebar Location
workbench.sidebarLocation.description: Where the primary sidebar is docked.

workbench.panelAlignment.title: Panel Alignment
workbench.panelAlignment.description: Controls how far the bottom panel spans on desktop: under the editor only (center), also under the left or right sidebar, or under both (justify).

editor.fontFamily.title: Font Family
editor.fontFamily.description: Controls the font family of the editor.

editor.lineHeight.title: Line Height
editor.lineHeight.description: Line height in pixels. 0 uses 1.55 × font size.

editor.fontLigatures.title: Font Ligatures
editor.fontLigatures.description: Enables font ligatures when the font supports them.

editor.tabSize.title: Tab Size
editor.tabSize.description: The number of spaces a tab is equal to.

editor.detectIndentation.title: Detect Indentation
editor.detectIndentation.description: Detect Tab Size and Insert Spaces from file contents on open.

editor.renderIndentGuides.title: Indentation Guides
editor.renderIndentGuides.description: Render vertical guides for each indent level.

editor.renderWhitespace.title: Render Whitespace
editor.renderWhitespace.description: Controls how the editor renders whitespace characters.

editor.minimap.title: Minimap
editor.minimap.description: Show a minimap of the document.

files.autoSave.title: Auto Save
files.autoSave.description: Controls auto save of editors that have unsaved changes.

files.autoSaveDelay.title: Auto Save Delay
files.autoSaveDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds after which an editor is saved automatically. Applies when Auto Save is afterDelay.

editor.formatOnSave.title: Format On Save
editor.formatOnSave.description: Format a file on save. A formatter must be available.

editor.defaultFormatter.title: Default Formatter
editor.defaultFormatter.description: Formatter used when several are available.

terminal.fontSize.title: Terminal Font Size
terminal.fontSize.description: Font size in pixels for the terminal.

terminal.scrollback.title: Scrollback
terminal.scrollback.description: Maximum number of lines kept in the terminal buffer.

terminal.confirmOnKill.title: Confirm On Kill
terminal.confirmOnKill.description: Ask before killing a terminal with a running process.

scm.autoFetch.title: Auto Fetch
scm.autoFetch.description: Periodically fetch from the default remote.

files.associations.title: File Associations
files.associations.description: Map filename or workspace-relative glob patterns to language IDs. Explicit associations take precedence over built-in detection.

languageServers.title: Language Servers
languageServers.description: Configure enabled state, selectors, rootMarkers, executable, args, env, initializationOptions, settings, and priority by server ID. Servers install on first use in a trusted runtime. License keys belong in the runtime-local credential file.

initializationOptions.description: Server-specific initialization options. Store license credentials in the runtime credential file.

settings.description: Server-specific configuration; nested objects merge across files.

ui.fontFamily.title: UI Font Family
ui.fontFamily.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

ui.fontSize.title: UI Font Size
ui.fontSize.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

ui.fontWeight.title: UI Font Weight
ui.fontWeight.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

ui.fontStyle.title: UI Font Style
ui.fontStyle.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

ui.lineHeight.title: UI Line Height
ui.lineHeight.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

ui.letterSpacing.title: UI Letter Spacing
ui.letterSpacing.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

ui.fontLigatures.title: UI Font Ligatures
ui.fontLigatures.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

terminal.fontFamily.title: Terminal Font Family
terminal.fontFamily.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

terminal.fontWeight.title: Terminal Font Weight
terminal.fontWeight.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

terminal.fontStyle.title: Terminal Font Style
terminal.fontStyle.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

terminal.lineHeight.title: Terminal Line Height
terminal.lineHeight.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

terminal.letterSpacing.title: Terminal Letter Spacing
terminal.letterSpacing.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

terminal.fontLigatures.title: Terminal Font Ligatures
terminal.fontLigatures.description: Overrides theme typography. Reset restores the theme value.

workbench.iconTheme.title: File Icon Theme
workbench.iconTheme.description: Select a locally installed icon theme. Unavailable selections use Oxbit defaults until restored.

workbench.productIconTheme.title: Product Icon Theme
workbench.productIconTheme.description: Select a locally installed icon theme. Unavailable selections use Oxbit defaults until restored.

editor.semanticHighlighting.title: Semantic Highlighting
editor.semanticHighlighting.description: Color symbols using language server information.

editor.inlayHints.types.title: Type Inlay Hints
editor.inlayHints.types.description: Show supported type hints in the visible editor.

editor.inlayHints.parameters.title: Parameter Inlay Hints
editor.inlayHints.parameters.description: Show supported parameter hints in the visible editor.

editor.largeFileIntelligence.title: Large File Intelligence
editor.largeFileIntelligence.description: Allow full semantic highlighting and inlay hints for files larger than 1 MiB.

editor.embeddedCode.highlighting.title: Highlight Code Fences
editor.embeddedCode.highlighting.description: Highlight fenced code in Markdown and in comments with the fence's language.

editor.embeddedCode.languageServers.title: Language Servers in Code Fences
editor.embeddedCode.languageServers.description: Send fenced code in Markdown and in comments to the language server for its language, for completion, hover, signature help, semantic highlighting and inlay hints.

editor.embeddedCode.diagnostics.title: Problems in Code Fences
editor.embeddedCode.diagnostics.description: Show language server problems for fenced code. Snippets that use undeclared names or missing packages report errors.

enabled.description: Index project dependencies, imports and related files.

project.intelligence.title: Project Intelligence
project.intelligence.description: Partial overrides of project.json intelligence. Objects merge across files.

catalog.description: Discover file schemas through SchemaStore. Bundled Oxbit settings support remains available.

download.description: Allow remote schema downloads; cached and bundled schemas work offline.

url.description: Schema URL or workspace file URI.

project.schemas.title: JSON Schemas
project.schemas.description: Partial overrides of project.json schemas. Association arrays replace lower arrays.

languageOverrides.description: Settings for a language ID, such as [mdx] or [php]. Runtime project options belong at the top level.
